messages.author: f923f5395925a18d
messages.subject: Shinyapps publication error
parts:
I was trying to publish my app to shinyapps.io, but I got the following error:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...Error: Unable to retrieve package records for the following packages:
- "ape", "xtable"
Execution halted

Any thoughts? Could this be due to dev versions of these packages?
The app is running fine locally...

Thanks in advance,
Will

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Shinyapps publication error
parts:
Have you tried install.packages(c('ape', 'xtable')) before deploying the app?

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: f923f5395925a18d
messages.subject: Re: Shinyapps publication error
parts:
Actually, I realized I had beta of versions of both packages, neither of which were on CRAN, so the publication function was having trouble installing them on the server, I suppose.
I uninstalled both packages and installed them from CRAN and had no problems after that.
Thanks!
